verdict.rationale: Namecheap has a public XML API with a sandbox, an official Go SDK, and a Terraform provider. Together they cover the core domain lifecycle: availability checks, charge-bearing registration and renewal, registrar lock, TLD listing, DNS record management, plus HTTPS dynamic-DNS updates. Nothing shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and the SDK's 'per-TLD API capabilities' listing suggests coverage varies by TLD. missing for 10: evidence of full UI-to-API parity (e.g., account management, transfers, privacy settings, billing), a complete API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of API breadth.
